Class LlamaCppCallOptions

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.llm.LlamaCppCallOptions
public final class LlamaCppCallOptions extends Object
The LlamaCppCallOptions class holds the chat fields a llama.cpp server accepts. A null field stays off the JSON. apply(ObjectNode) writes each set field. model, messages, and stream stay with LlamaCppLlmService. best_of and suffix are not fields. num_ctx, thread count, and slot count are not fields.
